QF.id: AIFM Fee Structure and Fund Performance_35

question.text: Which document must disclose the fee structure (management fee, incentive fee, hurdle, catch-up) of an AIF to prospective investors?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per SEBI AIF Regulations 2012 and referenced throughout Ch 9: PPM is the prescribed disclosure document for investors, covering all fees and terms. The Trap: Options A and B are internal/bilateral documents. Option C is irrelevant — AMFI governs MFs, not AIFs. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B covers PPM exhaustively; III-A/C covers PPM audit per SEBI circulars. Manager's Pro-Tip: SEBI template PPM (2020 circular) requires a dedicated 'Fees and Expenses' section with illustrative tables. Use the 'Example 9.1/9.2' style worked examples — regulators appreciate clarity and LPs reduce back-and-forth on term sheet drafts.
